claims.text: Deep learning potentials can determine the melting temperature of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
Deep learning potentials can determine the enthalpy of fusion of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
Deep learning potentials can determine the entropy of fusion of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
Deep learning potentials can determine the volume change upon melting of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
Deep learning potentials can determine liquid thermodynamic properties of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
Deep learning potentials can describe high-entropy materials in both high-temperature solid and liquid states.
The proposed approach is applicable across a large compositional space.
Accurate prediction of thermodynamic properties is the mechanism by which deep learning potentials produce the proposed benefit.
Deep learning potentials will improve accuracy relative to current experimental and computational methods.
Deep learning potentials will improve the availability of the listed thermodynamic properties relative to current experimental and computational methods.
Deep learning potentials will improve the efficiency of determining the listed thermodynamic properties relative to current experimental and computational methods.
Current experimental and computational methods are the comparison baseline.
The hypothesis is limited to high-entropy alloys.
Applicability is limited to the specific type of high-entropy alloy studied.
Predicted melting temperature, fusion enthalpy and entropy, melting volume change, and liquid thermodynamic properties should be compared with experimental data.
The hypothesis is falsified if predicted properties fail to match experimental data within a margin of error.
